<section id="agent-workflow">
<h1>Agent workflow</h1>
<section id="normal-observation-logging">
<h2>Normal observation logging</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Check workspace status</span>

<span class="c1"># Initialize</span>

<span class="c1"># Create via structured bundle</span>
cat<span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&lt;&lt;&#39;JSON&#39; | repairledger repair apply --file - --dry-run</span>
<span class="s">{</span>
<span class="s">  &quot;schema&quot;: &quot;repairledger.structured_repair.v1&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">  &quot;operation&quot;: &quot;create&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">  &quot;repair&quot;: {</span>
<span class="s">    &quot;title&quot;: &quot;Example tool failure&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">    &quot;target_tool&quot;: &quot;example&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">    &quot;kind&quot;: &quot;tool_failure&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">    &quot;severity&quot;: &quot;medium&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">    &quot;status&quot;: &quot;observed&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">    &quot;components&quot;: {</span>
<span class="s">      &quot;summary&quot;: &quot;Summary here.&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">      &quot;context&quot;: &quot;Context here.&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">      &quot;tool_call&quot;: &quot;example command&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">      &quot;expected_behavior&quot;: &quot;Expected behavior.&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">      &quot;actual_behavior&quot;: &quot;Actual behavior.&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">      &quot;reproduction&quot;: &quot;1. Step one.\n2. Step two.&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">      &quot;impact&quot;: &quot;This matters because...&quot;,</span>
<span class="s">      &quot;suggested_fix&quot;: &quot;Add validation.&quot;</span>
<span class="s">    }</span>
<span class="s">  }</span>
<span class="s">}</span>
<span class="s">JSON</span>

<span class="c1"># Create for real</span>
cat<span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&lt;&lt;&#39;JSON&#39; | repairledger repair apply --file -</span>
<span class="s">{ ... same JSON</span><span class="w"> </span>...<span class="w"> </span><span class="o">}</span>
JSON

<span class="c1"># Validate</span>

<span class="c1"># Build</span>

<span class="c1"># Export report</span>
repairledger<span class="w"> </span>report<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span>
</pre></div>
